content.short: The central liquidity hub and primary decentralized exchange for the Base network, using a ve(3,3) model.
content.description:
Aerodrome Finance is the central liquidity hub and primary decentralized exchange (DEX) for the Base network, Coinbase's Layer-2. It utilizes a ve(3,3) vote-lock governance system where users lock AERO tokens to receive veAERO NFTs, granting them voting power over token emissions. This model aligns the interests of traders, liquidity providers, and governors to create a sustainable "flywheel" effect.

The protocol distributes 100% of fees and bribes to veAERO voters who direct emissions to specific pools. Aerodrome is optimized for deep liquidity and low-slippage swaps, serving as the foundational layer for the entire Base DeFi ecosystem.
